claims: The Hunger Games is based on Suzanne Collins' novels.
The Hunger Games 2012 film was directed by Gary Ross.
The Hunger Games story is set in a future North America named Panem.
Panem has 12 districts.
12 districts send one boy and one girl as tributes to fight to the death annually.
Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her sister's place.
Katniss Everdeen competes alongside Peeta Mellark.
Jennifer Lawrence plays Katniss Everdeen.
Josh Hutcherson plays Peeta Mellark.
Liam Hemsworth plays Gale Hawthorne.
Woody Harrelson plays Haymitch Abernathy.
Elizabeth Banks plays Effie Trinket.
Donald Sutherland plays President Snow.
The Hunger Games 2012 film was released in 2012.
The Hunger Games 2012 film has a running time of 2 hours and 22 minutes.
The Hunger Games franchise has over 23.5 million books in print in the US alone.
Sunrise on the Reaping is scheduled for release in November 2026.
The Hunger Games is available to stream on Peacock.
The Hunger Games is available to stream on Hulu.
